description: This Java class defines Swagger API documentation models for account number formats in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for CRUD operations.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger API schemas for account number formats.

classes.name: GetAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Response schema for retrieving account number formats.

classes.name: GetAccountNumberFormatsIdResponse
classes.description: Response schema for a specific account number format identified by ID.

classes.name: GetAccountNumberFormatsResponseTemplate
classes.description: Template response schema providing options for account types and prefix types.

classes.name: PostAccountNumberFormatsRequest
classes.description: Request schema for creating a new account number format.

classes.name: PostAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Response schema after creating a new account number format, returning resource ID.

classes.name: PutAccountNumberFormatsRequest
classes.description: Request schema for updating an existing account number format.

classes.name: PutAccountNumberFormatsResponse
classes.description: Response schema after updating an account number format, including resource ID and change details.

classes.name: PutAccountNumberFormatschangesSwagger
classes.description: Schema for changes made in a PUT request to account number formats.

classes.name: DeleteAccountNumberFormatsResponse
